title: The LifterLMS WordPress plugin before 10.0.5 does not perform a capability or nonce check in one of its quiz-question…
description: The LifterLMS WordPress plugin versions before 10.0.5 contain a vulnerability where an AJAX handler for quiz questions does not perform capability or nonce checks. This flaw allows any authenticated user with subscriber-level access to enumerate the titles of all published quiz questions, including those for courses they are not enrolled in.
